Question

Let’s say you want to make a spirolateral.

If the turn angle is \(\theta=60^{\circ}\) and the maximum segment length is \(n=7\), then which spirolateral is created?

You can use this tool:

https://artockthedino.github.io/pbl/spirolateral/spirolateral_generator.html


Answerlist

  • A
  • B
  • C
  • D
  • E
  • F
  • G
  • H

Solution

The correct answer is A.

Below I’ve listed the parameters used to generate all patterns:

  • A:
    • Turn angle = 60
    • Count max = 7

  • B:
    • Turn angle = 78
    • Count max = 8

  • C:
    • Turn angle = 45
    • Count max = 14

  • D:
    • Turn angle = 108
    • Count max = 19

  • E:
    • Turn angle = 170
    • Count max = 13

  • F:
    • Turn angle = 165
    • Count max = 6

  • G:
    • Turn angle = 120
    • Count max = 14

  • H:
    • Turn angle = 150
    • Count max = 14
